entries.en: The Amphimonadidae illustrations were sharp, but the captions were too small to read without magnification.
entries.zh: 双鞭滴虫科的插图很清晰，但图注太小，不放大就看不清。

entries.en: The amphinucleolus was clearly drawn, although the rest of the cell was only faintly outlined.
entries.zh: 双核仁画得很清楚，不过细胞其余部分只勾出了淡淡的轮廓。

entries.en: The painting of Amphion was damaged in transit, delaying the opening of the mythology exhibition.
entries.zh: 那幅描绘安菲翁的画在运输中受损，导致神话主题展览推迟开幕。

entries.en: The reviewer asked for a clearer explanation of how amphipathy had been assessed in the study.
entries.zh: 审稿人要求更清楚地说明，这项研究是如何评估两亲性的。
